exposure: Site of attachment of umbilical cord
cohort: The study collected 60 discarded placentae and umbilical cords at random from deliveries, with 30 from low birth weight deliveries (<2500 gms) and 30 from control deliveries (>2500 gms).
finding: Both maternal factors and anatomical variations of the placenta significantly influence fetal size and ultimately, birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500 gms) and control (>2500 gms)
